name: Tetrahedral Regularization
definition: A regularization term added to the optimization loss to prevent tetrahedral elements from becoming inverted (negative volume) or degenerate (volume approaching zero) during the optimization of vertex positions and colors.
summary: Tetrahedral Regularization is a differentiable penalty term that prevents tetrahedra from inverting or degenerating during optimization by applying a smooth softplus quality metric, avoiding topology-modifying methods.
